sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: CEMAC biometric-passport regulation
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government's institutional page publishes the CEMAC biometric-passport regulation. It creates distinct diplomatic, service and ordinary types and entitles Equatorial Guinean citizens to the ordinary CEMAC passport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Se establece tres tipos de Pasaportes Biométricos CEMAC ... Diplomático, de Servicio y el Ordinario.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries and provides electronic delivery of the visa certificate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

policies.title: Equatorial Guinean ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the Equatorial Guinean ordinary CEMAC passport, not a diplomatic or service passport. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days, with stated passport-validity and supporting-document requirements.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current all-country document does not identify an Equatorial Guinean ordinary-passport exception; this classification is medium confidence. Work, residence, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the ordinary CEMAC passport and required tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and required documents for carrier and final-admission checks.
